Form Q ∈ (ℤ[X])[X] by taking sidePlusA minus sideMinusA, lifting their first five polynomial arguments through Polynomial.C and replacing the final argument by the outer X. Its degree is at most 20: lhsPairAG has degree at most 20 in its final argument, and both Horner lists have length 21. Evaluation at each of the 21 distinct natural constants gives PhiPlusA i − PhiMinusA i = 0 by the bounded identity. Polynomial.eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq_zero, applied over the integral domain ℤ[X], therefore gives Q = 0. Evaluating at the arbitrary constant j proves the conclusion without hj. This includes j = 0 and every j ≥ 21; no division or nonvanishing assumptions are involved.
